headline: Netflix said it is replacing chief content officer Bela Bajaria with Peter Rice, a former Disney television chairman, from 26 Oct 2026.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a top-level change at a major streamer in a week of large layoffs, though the AI link is slight.
importance_line: Decides who chooses the shows and films for Netflix's global audience; the exit comes in the same week as Netflix's largest layoff, and the sources read do not say the two are linked.
summary: Variety reports, citing Puck's first report and Netflix's own announcement, that Bela Bajaria is leaving after nearly 10 years as Netflix's chief content officer and will be replaced on 26 Oct 2026 by Peter Rice, most recently chairman of Walt Disney Television. The change comes in the same week Netflix laid off about 1,000 people, around 6% of the company, its largest cut to date.
notes: Reuters original blocked; credited to Variety, which cites Puck as first reporter. Link to AI is slight; kept as curated.
